meta.project: Playwright E2E Test Suite for Backend & Frontend (Firebase Emulators)

product_overview: A Playwright end-to-end test suite and environment configuration that validates critical business flows (B2B, Educational, Personal) against local Firebase emulators and the backend API. Includes global test environment setup, happy-path and error-path flows for each scenario.
core_goals: Provide reliable local E2E tests that run against Firebase emulators (Firestore on 8085, Auth on 9099).
Force/ensure Firestore long-polling or otherwise mitigate WS timeout issues in CI/local to avoid flaky tests.
Validate critical business flows for three user types: B2B (company workflows), Educational (edu-domain flows), and Personal (natural person flows).
Detect and report gaps in server-side validation (e.g., missing edu-domain enforcement) before test implementation.

features.name: Global Test Environment Setup
features.description: Start and verify Firebase emulators, configure Playwright to use Firestore long polling/timeouts, and ensure frontend points to localhost emulators so tests run deterministically in CI/local.
user_flows: Start Firebase emulators on ports 8085 (Firestore) and 9099 (Auth) -> Configure Playwright to force Firestore long polling and adjust timeouts -> Start frontend dev server with AUTH_HOST=localhost:9099 and FIRESTORE_HOST=localhost:8085 -> Navigate to /health -> See 200 OK -> Run Playwright test suite -> See tests connect to emulators successfully

Start Firebase emulators on ports 8085 and 9099 -> Start frontend dev server with default production endpoints (not emulators) -> Navigate to /health -> See 200 OK -> Run Playwright test suite -> See Firestore WebSocket connection errors or timeouts

features.name: B2B Cycle (Company / Admin / Owner / Worker)
features.description: Seed a Super Admin, create a tenant/company, invite an Owner, Owner sets up their account and creates a Worker. Verify Worker only sees permitted modules and cannot access Super Admin routes.
user_flows: Seed Super Admin into Firebase emulator (precondition) -> POST /api/admin/login with Super Admin credentials -> Receive auth token -> POST /api/admin/tenants with company payload using auth token -> Receive created tenant id -> POST /api/auth/invite with Owner email and tenant id using Super Admin token -> Owner receives invite token -> POST /api/auth/tunnel/challenge with invite token -> POST /api/auth/tunnel/setup-password with password -> Owner authenticates and receives auth token -> POST /api/auth/invite with Worker email and tenant id using Owner token -> Worker receives invite token -> POST /api/auth/tunnel/challenge with Worker invite token -> POST /api/auth/tunnel/setup-password to finish Worker setup -> Worker authenticates and receives auth token -> Worker attempts GET /api/admin/tenants using Worker token -> See 403 Forbidden -> Worker accesses only permitted modules and sees expected UI/API responses for their role

Seed Super Admin into Firebase emulator -> POST /api/admin/login with incorrect Super Admin password -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Attempt POST /api/admin/tenants without valid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Education Cycle (edu-domain registration, doc analysis, validation)
features.description: Register a user using an educational email domain (e.g., .edu or specific domains like uda.cl) and exercise the document analysis / validation endpoints to confirm role assignment or pending validation behavior. Include negative test where a generic email should not receive EDU role.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with email using an edu-domain (e.g., user@university.edu) and required profile data -> Receive registration success response with role=EDUCATIONAL or status=PENDING_VALIDATION -> POST /api/edu/analyze-doc with the user's education document using auth token -> Receive analysis result and requestId -> POST /api/edu/validate/:requestId using authorized validator (admin) -> Receive validation success and role updated to EDUCATIONAL

POST /api/auth/register with a @gmail.com email using the edu registration flow -> Receive registration response -> Confirm returned role is PERSONAL or that registration is rejected/marked as not EDU -> Assert system does not assign EDUCATIONAL role to generic domains

features.name: Personal Cycle (Natural person registration with RUN/RUT)
features.description: Register a natural person with RUN/RUT and a generic email. Verify account creation, ability to query account existence by taxId, and immediate access to basic personal dashboard behavior.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with RUN/RUT and generic email address and required profile data -> Receive registration success and role=PERSONAL -> GET /api/public/accounts-by-id/:taxId with the user's RUN/RUT -> See account exists and correct basic profile data -> Observe basic personal dashboard access (immediate access expected)
POST /api/auth/register with missing or invalid RUN/RUT field -> Receive 400 Bad Request or validation error -> Confirm user account is not created

features.name: Public & Health Checks (supporting checks used by tests)
features.description: Use public endpoints and health checks to assert server availability and to query public data (branding, account existence) during test flows.
user_flows: Navigate to /health -> See 200 OK and service healthy
GET /api/settings/branding -> Receive public branding settings -> Use settings in UI assertions
GET /api/public/accounts-by-id/:taxId for a known taxId -> Receive account existence information
